caption: The drawing is rendered in black and white pencil, showing a large, highly detailed tankard or stein in the center, with a domed lid, a broad handle featuring decorative elements, and a round base with ridged and beaded patterns. The surface of the tankard displays subtle shading, indicating reflections and contours of the metallic material. The tankard features a thumb lever attached to the lid for opening. In the upper left corner, an inset drawing outlines the tankard in profile, emphasizing the curvature of the handle and shape of the lid and body. In the upper right corner, another inset shows a front view, focusing on the ornamental details on the hinge and the attachment of the handle to the main body. The entire composition is framed with rectangular borders around both the central figure and the two insets. The background is an uncolored, off-white paper.
title: Silver Tankard
